title: The Transfiguration

scenes.title: His Face Shone Like the Sun
scenes.note: The Bible does not name this mountain. Christians have long said it was Mount Tabor; some think it was Mount Hermon, near Caesarea Philippi.

bsb: Lord, it is good for us to be here. If You wish, I will put up three shelters—one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.
kjv: Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

bsb: While Peter was still speaking, a bright cloud enveloped them, and a voice from the cloud said,
kjv: While he yet spake, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them: and behold a voice out of the cloud, which said,

bsb: This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to Him!
kjv: This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased; hear ye him.

bsb: Do not tell anyone about this vision until the Son of Man has been raised from the dead.
kjv: Tell the vision to no man, until the Son of man be risen again from the dead.

puzzles.prompt: Who appeared and talked with Jesus on the mountain?
puzzles.hint: One gave God's Law; one was a great prophet.
God told the disciples to pay attention to Jesus.

reflect: For a moment, Peter, James and John saw Jesus' glory. God's command to them is for us too: “Listen to Him!”
discuss: What do you think Peter, James and John felt when they saw Jesus shining?
God said the same words at Jesus' baptism, and added “Listen to Him!” How can we listen to Jesus?
When the disciples were afraid, Jesus touched them and said “Get up. Do not be afraid.” How does Jesus comfort us?
prayer: Father, Jesus is Your beloved Son. Help us listen to Him every day. Amen.
